title: Represent SRD advancement, multiclassing, languages, and inspiration rules
description:
Problem
Several core character rules sections are present in the SRD source but are not adequately represented in the imported pack.

Evidence from the 2026-06-07 audit
Unrepresented or underrepresented sections include:
- Beyond 1st Level
- Character Advancement
- Multiclassing
- Alignment
- Languages
- Inspiration
- Standard and Exotic language tables
- Character advancement and multiclassing tables

Required behavior
- Import these sections as rule and/or table records with complete source text and provenance.
- Mechanically meaningful tables should be represented as table records, not only embedded prose.
- Preserve enough structure for future rules lookup to answer questions about advancement, multiclassing prerequisites, proficiency bonus by level, languages, and inspiration.

IMPORTER SAFETY
Importer safety: follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md. Do not weaken regression tests or audit expectations to match current generated output; fix parser/extractor behavior or document source-backed evidence that the expectation was wrong.
notes: Implementation complete; PR #187 open for review (https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/187, branch feat/srd-beyond-1st-level-rules-eshyra-0m9-18). 18 new rule records (chapter intro via new parseRules chapterIntro option + Multiclassing tree + Alignment/Languages/Inspiration) and the Multiclass Spellcaster: Spell Slots per Spell Level table (missed by 0m9.23). Generated diff: exactly +19/0/0; verify:worktree green (1387 passed/19 skipped). Close this bead when the PR merges.
close_reason: Merged to main as 5c97e61 (PR #187): 18 Beyond-1st-Level prose rules (chapter intro, Multiclassing tree, Alignment, Languages, Inspiration) + the Multiclass Spellcaster spell-slot table. Rule coverage 172->190, tables 18->19.
